In-Game Secrets

Activates during a match after faction selection. Dialogue portraits appear in the bronze-bordered HUD dialogue box at bottom-center; click it or wait eight seconds to dismiss.
01
greenekeyboard

Type greene

Force-spawn the Fields of Evil — Immediately spawns the Fields of Evil encounter: the House of Greene, Landry’s and Conner’s clans feuding around it, the hounds at the door, and the Warwagon.

Normally only an 18% random chance per map. The keyword can be typed any time during play after faction selection.

02
House discoveredgame event

Find the House of Greene

Discovery toast + Mr Greene dialogue — A discovery toast fires and Mr Greene’s portrait dialogue appears at the bottom-center HUD dialogue frame.

Line: “Welcome to my Fields, stranger. The hounds caught your scent a mile off.”

03
Landonian sightedgame event

First Landonian unit enters vision

Landry reveals himself — Landry, King of the Landonians portrait appears with his opening line.

Line: “You’re standing in my Fields. Bold move — I respect it.”

04
Boydonian sightedgame event

First Boydonian unit enters vision

Conner claims the ground — Conner, King of the Boydonians portrait appears with his opening line.

Line: “Swing true, fear nothing. This is Boydonian ground.”

05
Shepherd nearbygame event

First sight of Parker

Parker starts guidance checks — Parker the Shepherd greets the player, then checks in periodically while nearby and in view.

Line: “Oh — hello there! Parker’s the name. How are you holding up?”

06
Tucker sightedgame event

First sight of Tucker

Tucker approves the traveler — Tucker the Goldendoodle sniffs the player thoroughly, wags once, and trots back to the house.

Verdict: you passed.

07
Gatsby sightedgame event

First sight of Gatsby

Gatsby judges with confidence — Gatsby the French Bulldog stares at the player with absolute confidence.

He has never doubted himself. Not once.

08
House razedgame event

Raze the House of Greene

Forbidden hoard claimed — +500 Forbidden Knowledge and +200 Divine Favor are awarded.

Toast: “☩ The House of Greene has fallen. Their hoard of forbidden knowledge is yours.”

One-time reveals

Landry, Conner, Tucker, Gatsby, and Parker should each fire once per campaign unless discovery flags are reset.

Parker behavior

Parker may repeat nearby check-ins while in view, but throttle the timing so it feels like guidance rather than spam.

Greene override

Typing greene bypasses the 18% map roll and forces the Fields of Evil encounter immediately.

Landing Page Secrets

Two paths unlock pixel portrait cards on the marketing page: type a hidden name, or cycle through the footer sigil.
Current character-card visual direction: bronze RPG frames, pixel-font nameplates, and Greene universe titles.
Landry King of the Landonians landon · landry
Mr Greene House of Greene greene · austin
Tucker Goldendoodle tucker
Conner King of the Boydonians boyd · conner
Gatsby French Bulldog gatsby · hounds
Parker The Shepherd of the Fields parker · shepherd

Method 1 — Keyboard

Type any trigger word from the roster. It should work anywhere on the page with no focused input required.

Method 2 — Footer ◈

Click the faint ◈ symbol on the right side of the footer copyright line to cycle through all six cards in order.

Dismissal

Dismiss any landing-page portrait card with Esc or by clicking outside the card.

Brand Continuity Assets

Previously generated Shadow of the Watchers assets are embedded as tone references so the cheat sheet stays visually aligned with the current Greene / Landonian / Boydonian / Shepherd direction.
